definitions.gloss: 60th birthday, completion of the sexagenary cycle
definitions.explanation: The celebration of one's 60th birthday, marking the completion of the traditional Chinese zodiac cycle.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{還暦|かんれき}を{迎|むか}えた。
{還暦|かんれき}のお{祝|いわ}いをする。
{還暦|かんれき}には{赤|あか}いちゃんちゃんこを{着|き}る。
examples.english: People wear a red vest for their 60th birthday.

notes:
CULTURAL:
The 60th birthday marks the completion of the full cycle of the Chinese zodiac (12 animals × 5 elements). Traditionally celebrated by wearing red, symbolizing rebirth. Other milestone birthdays: 古希 (70), 喜寿 (77), 傘寿 (80), 米寿 (88), 卒寿 (90), 白寿 (99).
